title: FLOATRELIC / MAGNETIC BALANCE
core_formula: cheap repeated parts -> new structural material -> invisible physical force -> impossible-looking balance -> collectible artifact
core_lesson: TURN INVISIBLE FORCES INTO VISIBLE DESIGN.
secondary_lesson: MULTIPLY THE ORDINARY UNTIL IT BECOMES MATERIAL.
summary: Office staples, metal wire, a small magnet and a bead become a desk artifact in which a central relic visually hangs under the top arm.
learn: Ask what physical properties the found materials can contribute.
Part of a form can be distance, shadow, tension, magnetic field, balance, light or movement.
ONE CHEAP PART x MANY = NEW MATERIAL.
Contrast strict modular structure with a handmade irregular relic.
